targetTest: test accepted replay remains queued when the follow-up detail read is unavailable
expected: After an accepted single replay whose follow-up read is unavailable, rendered copy explicitly says processing status is unknown and identifies read retry; retrying the read restores current evidence without dispatching another replay.
actual: The accepted replay test failed because the post-acceptance state did not explicitly identify processing status as unknown and did not identify the recovery action as a read retry. The same run found generic Retry labels on webhook and event read recovery controls.
semanticAssessment: The named target executed and failed on the planned rendered-copy assertion. Existing assertions in the targeted test confirmed one accepted dispatch job, one replay-request event, one admin audit event, and status received before any read retry.
